final: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, n, n*1.0/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
